listings.title: GoldenTree Presents ~ A Collector's Eye: Original Art, Folk Art, Pop Surrealism & Holiday Treasures
listings.description: Discover an eclectic and thoughtfully curated collection of original artwork, festive holiday decorations, and distinctive home décor, all from the personal collection of a single owner with a passion for art, creativity, and unique design. This auction features an impressive selection of original paintings and artwork by James Bonstow, Liana Steinmetz, Jordan Nichole, EMYO, Christy Kinard, Diana Card, Seung Lee, Jennifer Lanne, and Laurie Messeroll, among others. The collection showcases a wonderful mix of artistic styles, including contemporary folk art, whimsical and expressive works, and pop surrealism, including the imaginative, dreamlike paintings of Laurie Messeroll. From colorful, playful compositions to more traditional folk-inspired pieces, the artwork reflects a collector drawn to originality, personality, and visual storytelling. Beyond the art, discover a charming assortment of Christmas and seasonal décor from Crate & Barrel, Restoration Hardware, and other quality brands. The auction also includes handcrafted needlepoint samplers, decorative accents, and an assortment of unique holiday and household treasures. Whether you're a collector of original art, drawn to the charm of folk art and pop surrealism, or searching for distinctive holiday decorations and home accessories, this auction offers a wonderful opportunity to acquire pieces from a carefully assembled private collection. An Eclectic Collection. Original Art. Whimsical Finds. Timeless Treasures. ________________________________________________________________________ PICK UP SATURDAY, 12/5/2026 - ASHLEY RD, NEWTOWN PA. THE ADDRESS WILL BE IN THE WINNING INVOICE. From elegant entertaining to standout statement pieces, this sale has something special waiting around every corner!
